description: init.sh creates .venv, installs, lints and runs all tests offline. A conftest guard blocks non-local network and a test proves it.
Fictional city code file with 25 rules (ID, section, text, check type, parameters) and a schema check.
Seeded generator writes 300 synthetic applications with hidden answer keys, critical violations, edge cases and messy formatting. Same seed gives the same bytes.
The 300 applications split into 200 dev and 100 held-out before any tuning. data/split.json is committed.
Rule-based extractor pulls every field with a confidence score.
Rules R01 to R05 (paperwork and district) have pass, fail and edge tests.
steps: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_rules.py -k 'R01 or R02 or R03 or R04 or R05'

description: Rules R06 to R10 (setbacks, coverage, height) have pass, fail and edge tests.
steps: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_rules.py -k 'R06 or R07 or R08 or R09 or R10'

description: Rules R11 to R19 (deck) have pass, fail and edge tests.
steps: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_rules.py -k 'R11 or R12 or R13 or R14 or R15 or R16 or R17 or R18 or R19'

description: Rules R20 to R25 (addition) have pass, fail and edge tests, and every rule in the code file has all three.
A missing or low-confidence field always returns needs-human, never pass.
Reviewer checklist in Markdown and a review queue of needs-human items.
Correction letter in plain language with section citations. Every cited section exists and matches its rule. A fake section ID raises an error.
Audit log of every decision with inputs, rule version, code hash and extractor.
permitcheck eval writes field F1, violation precision and recall, false-approve rate with a Wilson interval, needs-human rate and citation validity for dev and held-out.
False-approve rate is zero on the seeded critical violations in the 100 held-out applications for the rule-based extractor.
LLM extractor in replay mode with a grounding check. Record mode exists behind a key.
False-approve rate is zero on the 100 held-out applications for the recorded LLM extractor.
README and every command line output say: synthetic data, no legal advice, not for production.
README has the quality-bar parts in order. A script writes its tables from results files and a test fails on drift.
CI workflow passes actionlint. LICENSE, CHANGELOG, CONTRIBUTING, issue templates, topics, social preview, static results page, DEMO.md and link check are present.
Study-later kit: docs/WALKTHROUGH.md, docs/INTERVIEW_QA.md with the interview points, DECISIONS.md.
Release check and hand-off: docs/RELEASE_CHECK.md, docs/HUMAN_STEPS.md and CHANGELOG.md with the release SHA, docs/handoff/COWORK_PROMPT.md, GITHUB_ABOUT.md, topics.txt.
